title: Average velocity calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the average velocity in the last second as displacement divided by time, yielding 6 m/s.

title: Midpoint velocity property
description: Important: The student must recognize that for uniform acceleration, the average velocity over an interval equals the instantaneous velocity at the midpoint of that interval.

title: Final velocity determination
description: Important: The student must correctly apply v = u + at to find the velocity at the moment of capture (v₂) using the midpoint velocity and the remaining half-second.

title: Total time of flight
description: Essential: The student must correctly solve for the total time from launch to capture using the initial velocity, final velocity, and acceleration, yielding 1.4 s.

title: Well depth calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly apply a kinematic equation (e.g., v² = u² + 2as) to compute the well depth, yielding 11.2 m.

title: Sign convention error
description: Pitfall: The student uses inconsistent signs for acceleration, velocity, or displacement (e.g., treating upward as positive but forgetting acceleration is downward).

title: Midpoint time misapplication
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly assumes the average velocity equals the velocity at the end or start of the 1-second interval, rather than at its midpoint.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The student explicitly verifies that all quantities are in consistent SI units before calculations.
